typeset

Templates

A template is a document you write in. The specification is the contract it keeps: a template sets the page and the scale and nothing else, and takes its typography from the published stylesheet rather than carrying a second copy of it.

iA Writer

The letter

A letter on A4 at 20mm on all four sides. EB Garamond at 11pt, ragged right, filling the page the margins leave. Markdown only, so it covers headings, body text, bold, italic, tables and footnotes — its own page states what that vocabulary reaches and what it does not, including why there is no two-column iA Writer template.

Download the letter template iawriter.css

Building one of your own

  • typeset.css — link it, add class="typeset", bind every face. The CSS bundle below carries both.
  • typeset.typ — for anything paginated: page-foot footnotes, running heads, table-of-contents page numbers, two columns.
  • spec.json — the values themselves, if you are teaching a third engine.

typeset — Adilson Carvalho. A template overrides the page and the scale and nothing else; where a template and spec.json disagree, the specification is right.
